type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

history_not_on_default_branch.subject: obligations: nota de progresso em B2 (FLT para primos regulares no atk-flt)
ci(atk-flt): informar se o flt-regular foi compilado do codigo-fonte
atk-flt: Beal quando um primo regular divide o mdc dos expoentes (via flt-regular)

verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.BealRegular.beal_de_flt_mdc
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {d x y z : ℕ}, FermatLastTheoremFor d → d ∣ x.gcd (y.gcd z) → ATK.BealRegular.BealFor x y z

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.BealRegular.beal_de_primo_regular
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {p x y z : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → IsRegularPrime p → p ≠ 2 → p ∣ x.gcd (y.gcd z) → ATK.BealRegular.BealFor x y z

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.BealRegular.beal_iff_forall_bealFor
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ATK.BealRegular.BealConjecture ↔ ∀ (x y z : ℕ), 2 < x → 2 < y → 2 < z → ATK.BealRegular.BealFor x y z

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.BealRegular.beal_mdc_cinco
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {x y z : ℕ}, 5 ∣ x.gcd (y.gcd z) → ATK.BealRegular.BealFor x y z

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.BealRegular.beal_mdc_quatro
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {x y z : ℕ}, 4 ∣ x.gcd (y.gcd z) → ATK.BealRegular.BealFor x y z

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.BealRegular.beal_mdc_sete
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {x y z : ℕ}, 7 ∣ x.gcd (y.gcd z) → ATK.BealRegular.BealFor x y z

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.BealRegular.beal_mdc_tres
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {x y z : ℕ}, 3 ∣ x.gcd (y.gcd z) → ATK.BealRegular.BealFor x y z

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.BealRegular.exemplos_novos
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ¬3 ∣ Nat.gcd 5 (Nat.gcd 10 15) ∧   ¬4 ∣ Nat.gcd 5 (Nat.gcd 10 15) ∧     ¬3 ∣ Nat.gcd 10 (Nat.gcd 15 20) ∧       ¬4 ∣ Nat.gcd 10 (Nat.gcd 15 20) ∧         ¬3 ∣ Nat.gcd 7 (Nat.gcd 14 21) ∧           ¬4 ∣ Nat.gcd 7 (Nat.gcd 14 21) ∧ ¬3 ∣ Nat.gcd 35 (Nat.gcd 70 14) ∧ ¬4 ∣ Nat.gcd 35 (Nat.gcd 70 14)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.BealRegular.sem_solucao_de_flt_divisor
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {d a b c x y z : ℕ}, FermatLastTheoremFor d → d ∣ x → d ∣ y → d ∣ z → 0 < a → 0 < b → 0 < c → a ^ x + b ^ y ≠ c ^ z
